description: An audacious life , where I make the choices and allow the things out of my control to flow #audacity #selfmastery #PersonalGrowth
transcript: I am audacious when it comes to my life. I am not focused on things that do not have my name on it and are not calling my name. And the more that I focus on my internal world, it gives me the leverage to occupy space at the 30,000 foot level. I am not worried about what's going on on the ground level because those things fix themselves every single time. Those miniscule tasks, those things that don't require me to be fully hands-on, they always fix themselves. And that has allowed me to release control. It is not my responsibility to take care of everything around me. My responsibility at the core is to nourish and develop my internal world. And that's where I exist.
